name: After § 35
title: REPORT on the implementation of the EU Youth Strategy 2019-2027
part_text: 35b. emphasises that vocational training programmes, particularly those aimed at young people, must explicitly include compulsory, high-quality, regular and paid training in occupational health and safety, with a view to preventing workplace accidents, occupational diseases and deaths at work, including in high-risk sectors; recalls that all training must be tailored to the specific tasks carried out and the inherent risks of each sector, and delivered in a language and format that is understandable to all workers, including those in subcontracting chains, temporary agency workers and migrant workers; reiterates that training must under no circumstances be used to relieve employers of their responsibility, as they remain fully responsible for health and safety in the workplace through preventive measures, adequate staffing levels, good work organisation and compliance with health and safety at work regulations
